dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Grandma, may I ask you a question? Nawaz and I have been thinking about this one, but we still don't get it.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Oh, of course you can, dear.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: So, uh... Grandma, is King Deshret really gonna come back from the dead...?

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Grandma?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Those fanatic believers! Can't they spare the children!?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Child, please, listen well. Though gods are indeed very powerful, even they can disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Being obsessed with things that have disappeared is madness. It is no way to live.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the desert children had the chance to learn a little more. Then they wouldn't easily fall for such lies...

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Child, I... I know this is a lot to ask, but please, study hard — you should learn a thing or two from Setaria.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I... I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Did you know that the rainforest is actually home to pigs that have mushrooms growing on them and fairies that have leaves on their heads?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I might've heard a thing or two.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Ooh! That means you must've read the "Aranara" picture book series too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Setaria brought me lots and lots of those books so that I can read them and learn words at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I thought that I might have trouble understanding them, but turns out that this stuff is super interesting!

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I just, uh... Sometimes, I get too excited to see the ending and read too fast, so I end up forgetting to record some words that I don't know yet...

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I'll ask Setaria the next time I see her, though!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Bye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Setaria...

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Setaria's been hanging around the village a lot these days, but she always looks super busy and hasn't been able to read with me much.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I get it, though! She's here to do some really important work, I'm sure of that! Granny says that the thing she's working on will make life in the village better!

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I wanna learn loads of stuff too so I can help her!
